privacy_purpose_title: Purpose and Legal Basis of Processing
privacy_purpose_desc: Personal data is processed for the following purposes: (a) responding to property information requests submitted through the contact form, based on the data subject's consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR); (b) managing commercial communications related to properties of interest.
privacy_data_desc: We collect the following personal data: first and last name, email address, phone number, inquiry message, and browsing data (technical cookies).
privacy_retention_desc: Personal data related to inquiries will be retained for a maximum of 24 months from the date of submission, or until consent is withdrawn. At the end of the retention period, data will be anonymized or deleted.
privacy_recipients_desc: Personal data may be shared with REI Immobiliare real estate agents for the purposes stated above. Data will not be transferred to third parties or outside the European Union.
privacy_rights_desc: The data subject has the right to:
privacy_right_withdraw: Withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent given before withdrawal
privacy_garante_desc: The data subject has the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante per la Protezione dei Dati Personali — www.garanteprivacy.it) if they believe that the processing of their data violates the GDPR.
privacy_provision_desc: Providing data marked as mandatory is necessary to process your information request. Failure to provide such data will make it impossible to process the request. Providing optional data is at the discretion of the data subject.
privacy_automated_desc: No automated decision-making or profiling is carried out.

privacy_consent_required: You must accept the privacy policy to submit your request
cookie_banner_description: This website uses technical cookies necessary for its operation. We do not use profiling or third-party cookies for marketing purposes.
